title: Nine Holes and One Buckle
subtitle: 腰带与地带 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 腰带与地带（生活与学习·服饰与区域）
meta: 主题语境：腰带与地带（生活与学习·服饰与区域）　|　核心词汇：belt　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 belt 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my father wore ① a belt that had been his father's and said the wearing was the whole of the inheritance. The ② belt, meaning the strap and not the land, was nine holes too long and was cut in March by somebody who asked first; a belt, he said, is the only thing you inherit that you are expected to shorten.

Every ③ belt in that house had been mended, and the ④ belt with the brass buckle, meaning the one kept for funerals and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever borrowed. A belt, my grandmother said, is nine parts leather and one part an occasion serious enough to need it; my father said the occasion is the part that never comes.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ belt was the whole of the country, meaning the region and not the strap. The ⑥ belt, meaning the strip of land and not any of that, is the only part of a map that is named after what grows there; a belt, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both a strap and a region. She said the region came first.

By 1966 the ⑦ belt had become a line on a chart, and the chart had become an argument about where it ended. The ⑧ belt of the whole thing, my father wrote in June, was nine holes and eleven years of wearing; a belt, he said, is either the strap with the brass buckle or the reason you know which county you are in. He said the county has never cared.

The ⑨ belt I remember is the one with the brass buckle, which was borrowed in 1969 and never came back. A ⑩ belt, my mother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being lent; every belt, she said, is a region that has agreed to look like a strap. She said the region was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 腰带（指那条带子，与土地相对）
C. 固定搭配：wear a belt 系一条腰带
D. n. 腰带（指屋里每一条）
E. n. 腰带（指带铜扣的那一条）
F. n. 地带；区域（指那片乡野／产区）
G. n. 地带（抽象：那片狭长的土地）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a belt that had been his father's
The belt, meaning the strap and not the land
the belt with the brass buckle
belt was the whole of the country
The belt, meaning the strip of land
the belt had become a line on a chart
The belt of the whole thing

answers.why: wear a belt 意为“系一条腰带”，1948 年父亲系着一条他父亲的腰带，他说系着才是这份遗产的全部。
belt 意为“腰带”，指那条带子而不是土地，它长了九个孔，三月被一个先问过的人剪短了。
belt 指屋里每一条腰带，那屋里每一条都补过。
belt 指带铜扣那一条（专为葬礼留着的那条），是唯一有人借过的。
belt 意为“地带、区域”，指那片乡野／产区，叔叔说 belt 就是那片乡野的全部。
belt 为抽象用法，指那片狭长的土地，是地图上唯一以那里长什么来命名的部分。
belt 意为“腰带”，到 1966 年这个 belt 成了图表上的一条线。
belt 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，父亲六月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个孔和十一年的佩戴。
belt 意为“腰带”，我记得的是带铜扣那一条，1969 年被借走，再没回来。
belt 为抽象总称，母亲说腰带是唯一会因为被借走而变好的东西。
